title: Guard the simplified collision converter's inputs and radii
summary: The collision converter now refuses, with a non-zero exit and nothing written, an output outside the source directory, one that resolves to the source or a layer it references, an existing file it did not write, and non-finite or non-positive radius settings. The checks are explicit exceptions, so they hold under optimized Python. The default output is byte-identical to the published variant, so the throughput and fidelity results are unchanged.
next: Decide with the program lead whether the variant becomes a club asset with its own one-robot and batch standing admission; keep solver iterations at 32 until that check.
reason: Input protection and argument validation for an unadmitted diagnostic tool; the generated asset, the approved USD, omniwalk and every gate are unchanged.
